evidence.ran: bash .loop/verify.sh (commands.test incl. claude plugin test mods/bussin-loop-status: 54 pass)

notes:
Did: an open task with screenshots draws, per screenshot, a thumbnail, its file name as caption and an 'Open full size' Button (open-<id>-<n>) running ['open', <loop path>/<shot>]. thumbnail() in register.tsx makes it with sips into one mktemp -d folder per session (file named by an FNV hash of format+path), cached by format, path and mtime in a module Map; desktop/vscode/mobile get a plain Svg wrapping the JPEG data URI in a fixed 480x320 box (skipped above 131072 characters), terminal an Image {png} at 40x15. Under them: 'You approved these' / 'You asked for changes' from row.review, 'Your review is waiting for the loop' when an inbox change has reviewFor === id (InboxChange gains reviewFor in types/index.d.ts), else Looks right (approve-<id>, writes {op: 'review', id, verdict: 'approved'}) and Needs changes (changes-<id>, not on mobile) opening Input review-note-<id> (rows 3) with Send to the loop (review-send-<id>, writes verdict 'changes' with the trimmed note; empty note toasts 'Say what needs to change before sending it') and Cancel. reviewDraftAtom (PluginState reviewDraft) holds the note and is dropped when any task is pressed. answerLogged's fs.read stub now answers {base64} for {as: 'bytes'}.
Learned: at runtime the test harness hands Image and Svg to every surface, whatever the typed table says, so the pane picks Image only for e.surface === 'terminal' and Svg for every other surface. The terminal Image validates its PNG (signature and IHDR), so tests need a real PNG, e.g. a 1x1 one. The first draw of an open task waits for its sips runs (up to 15 s each).
Lesson: [plugin-authoring] two gate runs failed because 'Image' in $.ui.resolve(e) and 'Svg' in ... are true on every surface at runtime → choose surface-specific elements by e.surface, as with Input on mobile.
Lesson: [plugin-authoring] a gate run failed because the Image stub bytes were not a real PNG → give Image tests a real PNG.
Lesson: [bussin-lean] review caught thumbnail files named by thumbs.size, which parallel draws of one task share (both thumbnails show the last one written), and an SVG string rebuilt on every redraw → name temp files from their cache key and cache the finished value, and make test stubs return distinct bytes per input so a swap shows.
